goal: Masken-Baukasten in zwei Schritten begründen: Schritt 1 Modell/Validierung/ApplicationPlan, Schritt 2 atomarer Vorlagenspeicher nach grünem Zwischen-Gate

guide_delta.summary: I88 Schritt 1 schafft ein unabhängiges Vorlagenmodell mit Raster-, Bindungs- und Kollisionsvalidierung sowie deterministischem Anwendungsplan; noch ohne Datenbankwrites.

tests_required: compile mask builder model and focused model test
valid template and deterministic application plan
overlap and duplicate field binding rejection
JSON contract roundtrip and unknown schema rejection
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because step 1 is an isolated new module
database tests because no database read or write path changes
TUI/Web runtime tests because no existing runtime is changed
visual tests because Drag and Drop UI starts only after the foundation is frozen
risks: step 2 persistence remains blocked until the model gate is green
real database writes are deliberately not part of I88
future UI must not bypass the model validation contract
non_changes: no writer lifecycle or direct SQL writes
expected_side_effects: mask templates become deterministic validated values independent of storage and UI
template application can be previewed as a plan without touching authoritative data
